data.gender_notes: Adeeba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adeeba is an Arabic name for girls. The name Adeeba is derived from the Arabic word 'adeeb' which means 'intelligent' or 'knowledgeable'. In Islamic history, Adeeba is the name of a wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Adeeba carries the meaning “Intelligent, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adeeba usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Adeeba is described as an effective and capable leader who managed to maintain peace and stability in her kingdom despite the frequent raids and invasions from neighboring powers.
